description: In combination with `esm-scen7-vl-SST`, quantifies the effective radiative forcing (ERF) of a failure of aerosol mitigation. Same as `esm-scen7-vl-SST`, except anthropogenic aerosol and aerosol precursor (BC, OC, NH3, SO2) emissions follow `esm-scen7-h` instead of `esm-scen7-vl`. Atmosphere-only counterpart of `esm-scen7-vl-Aer`.
